commits.subject: check-pick-entered DM + noon-ET lag escalation (2026-06-12 incident)
commits.body:
A delivered pick was never entered in the MLB app; nothing alerted
until Eric noticed the frozen streak a day later. The fetch path
behaved correctly (refused stale writes, froze doubles) — the gap was
that no check existed for 'pick in the app at all'.

- bts contest_fetch.has_prediction_for: pending rows prove entry.
- bts check-pick-entered (cron */15 11-23 ET): inside the 75-min
  pre-first-pitch window, fetch the profile and DM if today's pick has
  no prediction row. One DM per date; auth failures exit quietly (the
  fetch cron owns auth alerting; a false alarm minutes before pitch is
  worse than silence).
- contest_state health: gap==1 persisting past noon ET escalates
  INFO->WARN pointing at the entered-in-app question (fetch-failure DM
  never fires in this scenario because nothing fails).

10 new tests; suite 1925 green.
